text: Where a founder retains access to the smart contract behind the governance token, as with 3OH DAO, an internal attack by that founder would be remarkably easy.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Josh Bykowski, Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis (2023). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4529715

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis

abstract: If a DAO could have negative attack resistance, 3OH would be the DAO. With the founder having access to the smart contract, an internal attack by the founder would be remarkably easy.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: founder has not renounced ownership of the token smart contract
